enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Acid Blast 3: This weapon is covered in a strong and deadly acid, dealing 3d6 Acid damage on a successful hit, and an additional 3d6 Acid damage on a critical hit.
Insightful Shield Bashing +4: +4 Insight bonus to Increased chance of Secondary Shield Bash.
Acidic 3: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with acid, dealing 3d6 Acid damage on each hit.
Destructive Acid +2: Strikes with this weapon have a small chance to call forth a surge of incredibly corrosive acid, dealing 2d20+27 acid damage.
